description: Edit the visual regression monitor: add pages (a built-in one by key, or a page of your own by its address on the site, e.g. "/pricing"; up to 10 of your own), rename or re-point a page of your own, change any page's masks (CSS selectors painted over before comparing, for clocks, carousels, ads), remove pages, and set devices, browsers, full-page capture, the change threshold (percent) and the AI review. A page whose masks or address change gets a new baseline: its next run captures one for the user to approve. At most 40 screenshots a run (pages × devices × browsers). get_check lists the current pages and their keys.

label.description: A name for a page of your own (up to 60 characters)

masks.description: CSS selectors to mask on this page

page.description: A built-in page Relvato finds by itself

url.description: Or a page of your own: its address on the site (full URL or a path like /pricing)

aiReview.description: Let AI review a change before it alerts (default on)

fullPage.description: Capture the whole page (default) or only the first screen

remove.description: Keys of pages to stop checking

thresholdPercent.description: How much of a page may change before it counts, 0-50 (default ~1)

label.description: Pages of your own: a new name

masks.description: Replaces the page's masks ([] removes them)

url.description: Pages of your own: a new address

name: update_visual_monitor
title: Change the visual monitor's pages
